text:
maria_cs: FYI NovaLabs onboarding getting short 429s immediately after SDK init when they run their browser smoke (25 parallel tabs).
ryan_support: do we have their browser SDK logs or network traces?
maria_cs: they pasted a chrome netlog excerpt and browser console: 
```
[net] HTTP/2 stream reset (ERR_HTTP2_INADEQUATE_TRANSPORT_SECURITY)\n[app] creating new connection to api.redwood.ai \n[app] POST /v1/generate -> 429 (rate_limit)
```
ryan_support: interesting — lots of stream resets followed by many fresh connection attempts. could be hitting per-ip new-connection throttles or edge connection limits.
evan_engineer: if the browser tests spin up many short-lived tabs, we can end up with a connection churn spike. our edge limits new TCP/TLS handshakes per second per upstream, and we rate-limit heavy connection churn to protect capacity.
meera_infra: can you share a sanitized request header from a failing request? looking for protocol hints, alt-svc, or grpc flags.
maria_cs: sample headers from their trace: 
```
:method: POST\n:scheme: https\n:user-agent: novalabs-web/0.3.0\n:protocol: HTTP/2\n:sec-fetch-site: same-origin\n:cookie: <redacted>\n:x-tenant-id: novalabs-42\n```
evan_engineer: confirms HTTP/2 and many short-lived streams. mitigation path: (1) recommend NovaLabs reduce parallel tab inits or add client-side concurrency cap → immediate improvement; (2) short-term infra tweak: increase per-tenant new-connection allowance for novalabs-42 for onboarding window (timeboxed, canary); (3) longer-term SDK change: add connection pooling/sharing across tabs (or use shared worker) and retry jitter to avoid retry storms.
meera_infra: I can temporarily raise the new-conn rate cap for novalabs-42 and will canary at 5% of their traffic first. need approval to timebox to 6h.
maria_cs: NovaLabs wants fast turn so they're happy with a temporary infra change; they've scheduled a 15m call in 20m and will throttle their harness during that time if we request.
ryan_support: also check their TLS client config; some resets reference inadequate transport security which may be client-side downgrade causing connection re-establish. ask them to ensure modern TLS ciphers in the browser environment.
evan_engineer: action items: 1) meera_infra: deploy tenant-scoped new-conn allowance (PR-60321) canary 5% → 100% if healthy, timebox 6h. 2) evan_engineer: prepare an SDK guidance doc for web integrations recommending shared worker connection reuse and concurrency cap. 3) maria_cs: confirm customer will cap parallel tabs during canary and paste post-call logs.
ci-bot: queued deploy job for PR-60321 by meera_infra (canary=5%)
meera_infra: canary started; monitoring handshake rate and per-upstream queue. will abort if any cross-tenant impact shows.
maria_cs: booked call at 18:40 UTC with NovaLabs. I'll follow up here with their traces and whether throttling helps. :thumbsup:
